name: http-cookie-handling-not-browser-cookie-db
note: A web framework's HTTP-cookie handling: quoted 'cookies' / 'Cookies' property access (next-auth, cookies-next: req["cookies"], TmpCookiesObj) matched the browser-Cookies-DB credential target. 'Cookies'/'Login Data'/'Web Data' are common words, so they now require a browser-profile-path co-indicator (User Data / Application Support / AppData / a browser name used as a path segment); real Chrome/Firefox cookie theft always references the profile directory. Note the Next.js 'edge' runtime token, which must not be read as the Edge browser. A read of the actual browser Cookies DB (with a profile path) still blocks. Regression guard for the deeper-corpus false-block fixes.
